A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

ConsultationRequest.title: ConsultationRequest
ConsultationRequest.description: A WOR consultation traject (adviesaanvraag art. 25 / instemmingsverzoek art. 27 WOR): a statutory request/response exchange in which the bestuurder submits a request to the ondernemingsraad (a universal GovernanceBody with bodyType works-council), it is treated in overlegvergaderingen and optionally preceded by an achterbanraadpleging, formally answered with an advies/instemming, and closed by recording the bestuurder's decision, including the art. 25 lid 6 one-month opschortingstermijn when the bestuurder deviates from the advice. The traject is a declarative lifecycle on this one schema (ADR-031). It is explicitly NOT the citizen-participation PublicConsultation (public opinion gathering) and NOT a Decision subtype (it may link to a routed Decision via relatedDecision). CONSTRAINT: opschortingTot applies to an adviesaanvraag whose besluitOutcome is afwijkend-van-advies ONLY (never to instemmingsverzoeken or besluiten conform advies) and is derived as besluitDate + 1 month, this conditional derivation is not expressed with a composition keyword (no allOf/anyOf/oneOf ever) and is enforced at besluit-recording time (dialog + server-side validation, design D3 fallback), documented here. Submitted documents attach via the Files leaf / DigitalDocument relations. Confidentiality is high: no public publication surface is introduced (deliberate contrast with the toezeggingenlijst); objects stay behind OR RBAC. ADR-006 addendum (consultation-discriminator, 2026-08-19): exempted from folding into PublicConsultation as a genuinely distinct concept (10% measured field overlap, no public-authorization block, x-schema-org Action vs. Event, live constituencyConsultation reference to MemberConsultation): see openspec/architecture/adr-006-mode-adaptation-over-parallel-entities.md.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-WCC-002). Canonical dialect verbatim (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'states'-only/'default'). ontvangen -> in-behandeling -> (achterbanraadpleging) -> overlegvergadering -> vastgesteld -> verzonden -> besluit-ontvangen -> afgerond. achterbanraadpleging is an optional step (in-behandeling goes to either achterbanraadpleging or directly to overlegvergadering; achterbanraadpleging -> overlegvergadering). overlegvergadering -> in-behandeling allows repeat overleg rounds. ingetrokken is reachable from every non-terminal state before verzonden (ontvangen/in-behandeling/achterbanraadpleging/overlegvergadering/vastgesteld) and, with afgerond, is terminal. No app-side state machine.

subject.nl: Bestuurder wijkt af van het advies: {{subject}}

consultationBesluitAfwijkend._note: Afwijkend-besluit notification to OR members (REQ-WCC-006). Fires on the updated event when besluitOutcome becomes afwijkend-van-advies (art. 25 lid 6 relevance). Recipients approximate the OR members via object-acl(read) + decidesk-members group, because no recipient kind targets the governanceBody membership set directly.

consultationRappelBeforeResponseDate._note: Pre-response-date rappel (REQ-WCC-007). intervalSec 1209600 (~14 days) is PROVISIONAL (design D5 open question — tuning deferred to a future admin-settings change). Filter targets non-terminal lifecycle states before verzonden only, so no rappel fires for verzonden/besluit-ontvangen/afgerond/ingetrokken. Same window-semantics caveat as the toezeggingen-register pattern: the 'requestedResponseDate within window' vs 'past date' distinction is carried by the scheduled engine's window semantics, which this simple filter shape cannot express as a date comparison — verify OR's scheduled-notification engine interprets these two triggers as before/after-date rappels during live import.

subject.nl: Rappel: WOR-traject over de gevraagde reactiedatum — {{subject}}
subject.en: Reminder: works-council consultation past its requested response date — {{subject}}

consultationRappelOverdue._note: Overdue rappel (REQ-WCC-007). intervalSec 604800 (weekly) is PROVISIONAL. Filters non-terminal lifecycle states before verzonden, so no notification fires for verzonden/besluit-ontvangen/afgerond/ingetrokken. Same window-semantics caveat as consultationRappelBeforeResponseDate.

consultationOpschortingExpiry._note: Opschortingstermijn-expiry notice (REQ-WCC-007). intervalSec 604800 (weekly) is PROVISIONAL. Filter targets lifecycle besluit-ontvangen (where a running opschortingTot can exist). The 'opschortingTot within/at the window' predicate is not expressible in this filter DSL — same window-semantics caveat as the rappels; verify OR's scheduled-notification engine interprets opschortingTot during live import. Only meaningful when opschortingTot is set (afwijkend adviesaanvraag).

type.title: Type
type.description: The WOR request type. adviesaanvraag = advice request (art. 25 WOR); instemmingsverzoek = consent request (art. 27 WOR). Required. Drives the art. 25 lid 6 opschorting derivation (adviesaanvraag only, see opschortingTot).

worArticle.title: WOR article
worArticle.description: The WOR article reference, free-form so art. 30 and sub-clause references fit (e.g. 'art. 25 lid 1 sub d WOR'). Required.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of the request (the voorgenomen besluit put to the OR). Required.

director.title: Bestuurder
director.description: Reference to the bestuurder who submitted the request (the requester; WOR art. 1 lid 1 sub e; schema:Action agent). Not an OR member. Required.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the ondernemingsraad the request is directed to: a universal GovernanceBody (: bodyType works-council, added additively to the base register; never a parallel schema). Required.

receivedDate.title: Received date
receivedDate.description: Date the request was received by the OR. Required.

requestedResponseDate.title: Requested response date
requestedResponseDate.description: Date by which the bestuurder asked for a response. Optional. A request attribute, NOT a statutory deadline (the WOR sets only a redelijke termijn, design D5): rappels warn but never block, and no lifecycle guard references it. Drives the declarative rappels and the overdue dashboard KPI.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Traject status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): ontvangen -> in-behandeling -> (achterbanraadpleging) -> overlegvergadering -> vastgesteld -> verzonden -> besluit-ontvangen -> afgerond, with achterbanraadpleging optional, a repeat-overleg loop (overlegvergadering -> in-behandeling), and ingetrokken reachable before verzonden. afgerond and ingetrokken are terminal.

consultationMeeting.title: Overlegvergadering
consultationMeeting.description: Optional reference to the overlegvergadering (WOR art. 25 lid 4) where the traject is discussed. Reuses the universal Meeting schema: no works-council-specific meeting schema exists. The meeting's agenda item links back via agendaItem.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Optional reference to the AgendaItem under which the traject is treated in the overlegvergadering. Reuses the universal AgendaItem schema.

constituencyConsultation.title: Achterbanraadpleging
constituencyConsultation.description: Optional reference to the raadpleging/poll object owned by the constituency-consultation capability (member-consultation slug) that the OR started for this traject. This capability defines NO poll mechanics of its own (no question schema, no response tallying): it only points at one. The relation is optional (nullable, not required), so a traject with no raadpleging keeps a usable plain lifecycle status and a detail page with an empty reference.

responseOutcome.title: Response outcome
responseOutcome.description: The OR's formal response outcome. positief-advies / advies-met-voorwaarden / negatief-advies for an adviesaanvraag; instemming-verleend / instemming-geweigerd for an instemmingsverzoek. Optional until the response is recorded.

responseText.title: Response text
responseText.description: The text of the OR's formal advies/instemming. Optional.
responseText.example: De OR adviseert positief onder voorwaarde van een sociaal plan en een evaluatiemoment na 12 maanden.

responseDate.title: Response date
responseDate.description: Date the OR sent its formal response. Optional.

responseDocument.title: Response document
responseDocument.description: Optional reference to the generated formal advies/instemming document (DigitalDocument). Generated by ConsultationResponseDocumentService (imperative, out of declarative-core scope) mirroring the resolution-minutes Docudesk delegation pattern: markdown canonical, PDF opportunistic with an honest fallback.

relatedDecision.title: Related decision
relatedDecision.description: Optional reference to a routed Decision when the underlying ondernemersbesluit is modelled as one. When set, the OR's formal response is recorded on that Decision's advisory DecisionStage per the existing decision-methods method=advice semantics (actor sets the non-binding 'advised' outcome directly); this capability introduces no new outcome-derivation mechanism.

decisionOutcome.title: Besluit outcome
decisionOutcome.description: The bestuurder's decision after the OR response (WOR art. 25 lid 5 schriftelijke mededeling). conform-advies / afwijkend-van-advies for an adviesaanvraag; conform-instemming for an instemmingsverzoek; niet-doorgezet when the request is dropped. Recording it accompanies the transition to besluit-ontvangen. afwijkend-van-advies on an adviesaanvraag triggers the art. 25 lid 6 opschortingstermijn (see opschortingTot) and the afwijkend-besluit notification.

decisionText.title: Besluit text
decisionText.description: The text of the bestuurder's decision / mededeling. Optional.
decisionText.example: Bestuurder besluit tot uitbesteding zonder evaluatiemoment; sociaal plan wordt overgenomen.

decisionDate.title: Besluit date
decisionDate.description: Date the bestuurder recorded the decision. Optional. Basis for opschortingTot (besluitDate + 1 month) when the decision is an afwijkend besluit on an adviesaanvraag.

suspensionTo.title: Opschorting until
suspensionTo.description: The art. 25 lid 6 opschortingstermijn end date: the bestuurder must suspend execution for one month when deviating from the OR advice. Derived as besluitDate + 1 month for an adviesaanvraag whose besluitOutcome is afwijkend-van-advies ONLY. NEVER for instemmingsverzoeken or besluiten conform advies. This conditional derivation is expressed WITHOUT any composition keyword (no allOf/anyOf/oneOf); per design D3 it is set/validated at besluit-recording time (dialog + server-side validation) rather than by an unproven x-openregister-calculations rule, and the detail page surfaces the running termijn. Empty when no opschorting applies.
